title: Cong to oppose delimitation bill, raise NEET, Ram temple issues
description: The Congress on Thursday said it would make “every effort to maintain the unity and solidarity of all Opposition parties” and strongly oppose Constitution amendment bills related to delimitation and removal of ministers and chief ministers, if taken up during the upcoming Parliament session, while cornering the government over the Ram Mandir donation theft, NEET papers leak and the ethanol blending among other issues
